senses.gloss: m. (פָּתַק; v. פִּיטֵּק) ball, stone, tablet, ballot; lot, decree. Tanḥ. B’haʿăl. 12 כל מי שהיה עולה בידו פ׳ כתוב וכ׳ he who drew a ballot on which ‘elder’ was written. Tanḥ. B’midb. 21 אם עלה בידו פ׳ כתוב וכ׳ if he drew a ballot on which ‘Levi’ was written, he knew that a Levite had redeemed him.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:10">Num. R. s. 4</cite> [read:] <he>מי אומר לך שאם היה שם פי׳ של לוי שלא וכ׳</he> who tells thee that I should not have drawn it, had there been a ballot inscribed ‘Levi’ in the box? <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:10">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ כתב וכ׳</he> (read <he>כתוב</he>) a ballot inscribed &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 12a:16">Sot. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>לא היו בפִיתְקָהּ של חוה</he> they were not included in the decree pronounced on Eve (<cite ref="Genesis 3:16">Gen. III, 16</cite>).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 102a:7">Snh. 102ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 11:29">I Kings XI, 29</cite>) <he>יצא מפיתקה של ירושלים</he> (Rashi <he>מפִּתְקָהּ</he>) he went out of the destiny of Jerusalem (i.e. was to have no share in the welfare of Jerusalem); a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּתָקִים</he>, <he>פְּתָקִין</he> (Chald. form) <cite ref="Q00713"><he>פִּיתְקִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:10">Esth. R. to I, 2</cite>; v. <cite ref="D00131"><he>דָּדָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:6">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>לערב הביאו לו את הפ׳</he> in the evening they brought him the tablets (on which every traveller had written his name). Num. R. l. c. <he>כתב על … פ׳ לוי לוי</he> he (Moses) wrote on each of twenty-two thousand ballots, Levi &c. (v. <cite ref="Q00632"><he>פִּיטֵּק</he></cite>). Tanḥ. l. c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 17a:8">Snh. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>טלו פִיתְקֵיכֶם</he> draw your ballots; a. fr.
